g.text: SIMULATED · ORACLE TRIGGERS · NO KWS / ASR / HARDWARE MEASUREMENT
All declared cases, including deliberate failures
Each cell reports handoff state / complete-command checks passed. An aborted prefix never counts as a complete command.
Every expected behavior check can pass while a handoff or command-integrity result deliberately fails. See summary.json.
